description: This file defines a class GuzzleHandler that acts as a request handler to send PSR-7-compatible HTTP requests asynchronously using Guzzle 6, with custom error handling and option parsing.

classes.name: GuzzleHandler
classes.description: A request handler that sends PSR-7-compatible requests asynchronously using Guzzle 6 with error handling and customizable options.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the GuzzleHandler with an optional Guzzle ClientInterface.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Handles the PSR-7 request asynchronously, appending User-Agent header, and handles promise rejection with detailed error information.

methods.name: parseOptions
methods.description: Prepares and modifies request options, especially handling 'http_stats_receiver' callback and 'on_stats' functions.
